Auto Body & Collision Repair Marketing Kit 1.0.1

- Added campaign prompt files for seasonal campaigns, service pages schema, reputation/referral workflows, and digital ads/local SEO.
- Included package.json for structured deployment and dependencies.
- Added an example output file for Precision Auto Body Henderson.
- No changes were made to core documentation or compliance logic.

Auto Body & Collision Repair Marketing Kit v1.0.0

- Initial release of a compliance-focused marketing content generation kit for Nevada auto body shops and collision repair centers.
- Outputs marketing assets (emails, ad briefs, SMS, social media posts, service pages, reputation/referral systems, digital ads, and local SEO packages) screened against 7 regulatory compliance "moats."
- Ensures all content avoids costly OSHA, EPA, FTC, and local liability traps commonly missed by generic marketing tools.
- Fully documents compliance requirements specific to Nevada (Clark County), with principles applicable nationwide.
